SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-12-2010 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MAKHANI, MURSIL BHOJANI, NEELAM RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MEDINA, BRANDON $1,346.78 PRINCIPAL, $55.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,401.78, DEFENDANT MUST RETURN SECURITY DEPOSIT OF $1000.00 FOR FAILING TO COMPLY WITH CIVIL CODE 1950.5. IN ADDITION, DEFENDANT MAY OFFSET THE AMOUNT OWED BY PLAINTIFFS ON DEFENDANTS CLAIM. IN ADDITION, THE COURT AWARDS $246.78 IN RENT PAID BY PLAINTIFFS BEYOND THE END OF THE TENANCY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-12-2010 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON DEFENDANT'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT CROSS COMPLAINANT MEDINA, BRANDON RECOVER FROM CROSS DEFENDANT MAKHANI, MURSIL BHOJANI, NEELAM $575.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $625.00, PLAINTIFFS WAIVED SERVICE ON DEFENDANT'S CLAIM. THE COURT FINDS PLAINTIFFS LIABLE FOR PROPERTY DAMAGES WITH RESPECT TO THE REFRIGERATOR ($75.00), CARPET($200.00) AND CHAIRS ($300.00). THE AMOUNT OWED BY THE PLAINTIFFS SHALL BE APPLIED AS AN OFFSET TO THE AMOUNT OWED BY DEFENDANT ON PLAINTIFFS CLAIM. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
